description: Read the current HTML of one page on an iter0 canvas, with its version, so you can merge the person's own edits before pushing a revision. Free and read-only. A large page comes in parts: html holds the characters from htmlOffset, and while nextOffset is not null, call again with it as offset and append. Check that version is the same on every part.

designId.description: The canvas's designId from iter0_push_site, or any page's designId on it. Any other saved design the person owns also works.

offset.description: nextOffset from the previous part. Leave out for the first part.

pageKey.description: A pageKey from iter0_push_site or iter0_get_canvas_feedback.

name: iter0_read_canvas_page

bytes.description: The whole page's size in UTF-8 bytes.

changedSincePush.description: The saved page differs from the last HTML an agent pushed: someone edited it in iter0.

onCanvas.description: False when the person removed this page's frame from the canvas; its design is kept.

version.description: Pass as expectedVersion to replace this page.

title: Read a canvas page's code
